title: The state of case presentation in emerging dental groups
summary: Avora's AI listened to, transcribed, and scored 35,000+ real patient visits across emerging dental groups. Here's what separates high-production case presenters from everyone else.
body_markdown:
Framework


## Case presentation framework


This is the framework we used to grade the doctors in the sample against their production data. Every group runs case presentation a bit differently, but we needed one rubric we could apply across every visit — so we went with a standard six-step version.


Step 01


Assistant / TC


### Introduction & Understanding


Greet, clarify patient goals, outline visit clearly.
